Finding: Network policy does not explicitly restrict node-web egress to dotnet-api and platform endpoints
Remediation: Add namespace and egress NetworkPolicy allowing dotnet-api, DNS, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor only

Finding: dotnet-api queue and state dependencies are not documented with retry and timeout expectations
Remediation: Document queue/database endpoints, retries, timeouts, and failure modes in the dependency map

Finding: Key Vault CSI usage needs verification for all sensitive settings
Remediation: Confirm SecretProviderClass mounts are used and remove any plain secret values from environment variables

Finding: Resource requests and limits are not evidenced for each container
Remediation: Set or verify CPU and memory requests/limits in Helm or Kustomize overlays

Finding: Readiness and liveness probes are not captured in assessment evidence
Remediation: Record probe paths and thresholds; add missing probes before production rollout

Finding: ACR image scanning and vulnerability gates are not linked to rollout readiness
Remediation: Enable or verify Defender for Containers image scanning and define a high/critical vulnerability gate

Finding: Queue dead-letter and replay plan is not documented
Remediation: Document queue retention, dead-letter handling, idempotency, and replay procedure

Finding: SQL or state store backup and restore evidence is missing
Remediation: Confirm backup policy, point-in-time restore, and migration validation procedure

Finding: OpenTelemetry export is assumed but not validated end to end
Remediation: Verify traces, metrics, and logs reach Azure Monitor with service.name per workload

Finding: Workload identity bindings require least-privilege review
Remediation: Review federated credentials, service account annotations, and Azure role assignments for each service

Finding: Distroless or chiseled non-root runtime is documented but not evidenced in assessment
Remediation: Capture Dockerfile and pod security context evidence proving non-root immutable images

Finding: Ingress dependency and upstream owner are not recorded
Remediation: Identify ingress route, upstream owner, TLS responsibility, and rollback contact
